## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- a PostgreSQL 16 server is reachable at the `DATABASE_URL` provided by `.env.test`, and its role can create and drop databases (each item runs against its own isolated database)
- the `task-api` service built from this repository is available both as an in-process router and as a spawnable binary (`cargo run` or the compiled `task-api` executable)
- a Rust stable toolchain ≥ 1.100 with the `rustfmt` and `clippy` components is installed

**Persistent state:**
- `migrated-db` — a PostgreSQL database exists on which every migration shipped so far has been applied exactly once with matching checksums; the `tasks` table exists and holds zero rows. Used by: API-CREATE-01, API-CREATE-02, API-CREATE-03, API-CREATE-04, API-CREATE-05, API-CREATE-06, API-CREATE-07, API-CREATE-08, API-CREATE-09, API-CREATE-10, API-VALIDATE-01, API-VALIDATE-02, API-VALIDATE-03, API-VALIDATE-04, API-VALIDATE-05, API-VALIDATE-06, API-VALIDATE-07, API-VALIDATE-08, API-VALIDATE-09, API-VALIDATE-10, API-REJECT-01, API-REJECT-02, API-REJECT-03, API-REJECT-04, API-REJECT-05.

**Configuration:**
- `.env.test` at the repository root defines `DATABASE_URL` for the PostgreSQL 16 server above, and its variables are present in the environment of `cargo test`
- unless an item states otherwise: `HOST=127.0.0.1`, `PORT=<a free TCP port>`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=10`, `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=5`, `DATABASE_URL` pointing to `migrated-db`
- `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true` mounts the diagnostic route `GET /__test/slow?ms=<0..30000>[&hold_db=true]`, used only by `API-REJECT-04` to hold the database pool's connection; when the flag is unset or `false`, that path behaves as an unknown route
- "64 KB" means 65,536 bytes
- the `tasks` table can be read directly with SQL (outside the service) so items can assert persisted rows

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Format** — `cargo fmt --check` — every source file is already rustfmt-formatted; the command exits 0 with no diff.
- **Lint** — `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` — all targets (library, binary, tests) compile with zero clippy warnings.
- **Tests** — `cargo test` — every unit and integration test passes against isolated `#[sqlx::test]` databases on the PostgreSQL server named by `.env.test`.
- **Offline build** — `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build` — the project compiles from the committed `.sqlx/` metadata without contacting a database.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| `POST /tasks` with `{"title":"Write PRD"}` returns 201 with `status:"todo"`, `priority:"medium"`, `description:null`, `due_date:null`, a UUID `id`, and `created_at == updated_at`. | API-CREATE-01 |
| The response includes `Location: /tasks/{id}` matching the returned `id`. | API-CREATE-02 |
| A payload with all fields (`title`, `description`, `status:"in_progress"`, `priority:"high"`, `due_date:"2026-12-01"`) is persisted and returned with exactly those values. | API-CREATE-03 |
| A title of `"  Trim me  "` is stored and returned as `"Trim me"`. | API-CREATE-04 |
| A title of exactly 200 characters is accepted, and 201 characters returns 422 with a `details` entry for `title`. | API-CREATE-07, API-VALIDATE-04 |
| A missing title, `""`, or `"   "` each returns 422 with a `details` entry for `title`. | API-VALIDATE-01, API-VALIDATE-02, API-VALIDATE-03 |
| A description of 5,001 characters returns 422 with a `details` entry for `description`, and `"   "` is stored as `null`. | API-VALIDATE-05, API-CREATE-05 |
| `status:"DONE"` and `priority:"urgent"` each return 422 with the corresponding field in `details`. | API-VALIDATE-06, API-VALIDATE-07 |
| `due_date:"2026-02-30"` and `due_date:"12/01/2026"` each return 422 with a `details` entry for `due_date`. | API-VALIDATE-08, API-VALIDATE-09 |
| A payload with both an invalid title and an invalid priority returns a single 422 listing both fields. | API-VALIDATE-10 |
| Client-supplied `id` and `created_at` are ignored; the server generates its own values. | API-CREATE-06 |
| Malformed JSON returns 400 `invalid_json`, and a missing `Content-Type: application/json` returns 415. | API-REJECT-01, API-REJECT-03 |
| No row is inserted for any request that returns a non-2xx status. | API-VALIDATE-01, API-VALIDATE-02, API-VALIDATE-03, API-VALIDATE-04, API-VALIDATE-05, API-VALIDATE-06, API-VALIDATE-07, API-VALIDATE-08, API-VALIDATE-09, API-VALIDATE-10, API-REJECT-01, API-REJECT-02, API-REJECT-03, API-REJECT-04, API-REJECT-05 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service (in-process router or bound listener); assert response status, headers and body, and read the `tasks` table directly to assert persisted rows.

### Create Task

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `tasks` holds zero rows.

#### `API-CREATE-01` — minimal payload gets defaults
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"Write PRD"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `status` is `todo`, `priority` is `medium`, `description` is `null`, `due_date` is `null`
  - body `id` parses as a UUID
  - body `created_at` equals body `updated_at`
  - body `title` is `Write PRD`

#### `API-CREATE-02` — response carries a Location header
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"Write PRD"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - header `Location` equals `/tasks/` followed by the body `id`

#### `API-CREATE-03` — all fields are persisted and returned
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"Ship it","description":"Final review","status":"in_progress","priority":"high","due_date":"2026-12-01"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `due_date` are exactly `Ship it`, `Final review`, `in_progress`, `high`, `2026-12-01`
  - the `tasks` row identified by the body `id` has those same five values
  - `tasks` holds exactly one row

#### `API-CREATE-04` — title is trimmed
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"  Trim me  "}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `title` is `Trim me`
  - the stored `title` for the body `id` is `Trim me`

#### `API-CREATE-05` — blank description is stored as null
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","description":"   "}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `description` is `null`
  - the stored `description` for the body `id` is NULL

#### `API-CREATE-06` — client-supplied id and timestamps are ignored
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","created_at":"2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","updated_at":"2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `id` is not `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`
  - body `created_at` is not `2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`
  - no row with id `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001` exists in `tasks`

#### `API-CREATE-07` — title of exactly 200 characters is accepted
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"<200 × a>"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `title` has 200 characters

#### `API-CREATE-08` — description of exactly 5,000 characters is accepted
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","description":"<5,000 × a>"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `description` has 5,000 characters

#### `API-CREATE-09` — a past due date is accepted
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","due_date":"2000-01-01"}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body `due_date` is `2000-01-01`

#### `API-CREATE-10` — unknown fields are ignored
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","color":"red","extra":{"x":1}}`
- then:
  - status 201
  - body contains no `color` or `extra` field

### Validation

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `tasks` holds zero rows.

#### `API-VALIDATE-01` — missing title is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"priority":"high"}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`
  - body `error.details` contains an entry whose `field` is `title`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-VALIDATE-02` — empty title is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":""}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`
  - body `error.details` contains an entry whose `field` is `title`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-VALIDATE-03` — whitespace-only title is rejected

- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"   "}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`

  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`

#### `API-VALIDATE-07` — unknown priority is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","priority":"urgent"}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`

#### `API-VALIDATE-08` — impossible calendar date is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","due_date":"2026-02-30"}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`
  - body `error.details` contains an entry whose `field` is `due_date`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-VALIDATE-09` — non-ISO date format is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t","due_date":"12/01/2026"}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body `error.code` is `validation_error` and `error.message` is `Request validation failed`
  - body `error.details` contains an entry whose `field` is `due_date`

#### `API-VALIDATE-10` — several invalid fields are reported in one response
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"   ","priority":"urgent"}`
- then:
  - status 422
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"validation_error","message":"Request validation failed","details":[{"field":"title","message":"must be between 1 and 200 characters"},{"field":"priority","message":"must be one of: low, medium, high"}]}}`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

### Request Rejection

**Common given:** the service is running against `migrated-db`; `tasks` holds zero rows.

#### `API-REJECT-01` — malformed JSON is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":`
- then:
  - status 400
  - body `error.code` is `invalid_json`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-REJECT-02` — wrong JSON type names the field
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":5}`
- then:
  - status 400
  - body `error.code` is `invalid_json`
  - body `error.details` contains exactly one entry whose `field` is `title`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-REJECT-03` — missing Content-Type is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with body `{"title":"t"}` and no `Content-Type` header
- then:
  - status 415
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"unsupported_media_type","message":"Content-Type must be application/json","details":[]}}`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows

#### `API-REJECT-04` — unavailable database returns 503 and stores nothing
- given: the service runs with `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true`, `DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1` and `DATABASE_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECS=1`, and a `GET /__test/slow?ms=4000&hold_db=true` request is in flight holding the pool's only connection
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{"title":"t"}`
- then:
  - status 503
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"service_unavailable","message":"Database temporarily unavailable, please retry","details":[]}}`
  - the response arrives within 2.5 seconds of sending the request
  - `tasks` holds zero rows after the held connection is released

#### `API-REJECT-05` — body over 64 KB is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: POST /tasks with `Content-Type: application/json`, `Content-Length: 65537`, and a 65,537-byte body
- then:
  - status 413
  - body is exactly `{"error":{"code":"payload_too_large","message":"Request body exceeds 64 KB","details":[]}}`
  - `tasks` still holds zero rows
